> > `rust/python/src/entity_data.rs:91-100` > **🗄️ Data Integrity & Integration** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win** > > **Document the single-value type-tag exception.** > > `flat_property` returns the nominal value's rendered type tag for `IfcPropertySingleValue`, such as `IFCLABEL` or `IFCREAL`. The current unqualified wording says `value_type` is the shared member type or the property-class keyword. Consumers can therefore misclassify single-value properties. > > Update this sentence in the Rust docstring and its mirrored `.pyi`, API guide, and README text. > >
Suggested fix > > ```diff > -/// `value_type` is the members' shared type tag, else the property class keyword > -/// (`IFCPROPERTYTABLEVALUE`, ...). > +/// For `IfcPropertySingleValue`, `value_type` is the nominal value's rendered > +/// type tag. For other property kinds, it is the members' shared type tag, else > +/// the property class keyword (`IFCPROPERTYTABLEVALUE`, ...). > ``` > >
